name: daiver-prompt-view
description: A multi-line status line under the prompt: model, session, modes, agents, usage bars, git state and Clawd

borders.title: Show the frames
borders.description: The frames around your prompts, Claude's replies, tool calls, the spinner, command output and the status line (also /daiver-prompt-view:chat:show-borders [on|off])

history.title: Show the prompt history pane
history.description: A pane at the right with the prompts you sent this session, framed in the theme's history color; its × closes it (also /daiver-prompt-view:history:show [on|off])

resources.title: Show RAM and CPU
resources.description: The machine's memory and CPU use, on a line under the usage bars: [RAM: used/total | %] [CPU: busy cores/cores | %]

clodik.title: Show Clawd
clodik.description: Clawd, Claude's mascot, at the right edge of the status line, animated while Claude Code is busy

clodikAnimate.title: Animate Clawd always
clodikAnimate.description: Clawd animates all the time, not only while Claude Code is busy (also /daiver-prompt-view:clodik:animate [on|off])

clodikAnimation.title: Clawd's animation
clodikAnimation.description: The animation Clawd plays, or a random one every few seconds (also /daiver-prompt-view:clodik:animation <name>)

theme.title: Color theme
theme.description: The status line's colors, the agents line's included (also /daiver-prompt-view:view:theme <name>)
